messages:
Renee: FYI HelionCompute sent INV-HC-557 for $81,250 and the PDF lists billing to Redwood UK but our PO HC-2102 is for Redwood Inc (US). No PO number printed on invoice. Can AP hold payment? /cc @Derek @Sasha

ap-bot: invoice INV-HC-557 uploaded to AP queue (invoices/2026/Helion_INV-HC-557.pdf). auto-pay: true

Derek: AP here Please confirm hold. Because amount > $50k we need PO or exec sign-off. Also note entity mismatch (UK vs US) and vendor charged GST line.

Procurement: We have PO HC-2102 for $70,000 (approved by Ken) covering committed capacity. Looks like vendor billed additional consultancy and also invoiced to Redwood UK by mistake. No PO number on PDF.

Sasha: This was a scheduled capacity + ad-hoc performance tuning. Contract HC-MSA section 5 allows professional services but requires pre-approval for >$10k ad-hoc work. I don't see approval email threads.

Ken: Confirm PO HC-2102 exists. I did not approve extra $11k of services. If vendor mis-billed entity, they must reissue. If it's valid ad-hoc work, need retro approval from Eng lead + Procurement.

Derek: Marking AP hold: HOLD_ENTITY_PO. Ticket AP-7011 created to block auto-pay. Auto-pay disabled for this invoice.

Renee: Message sent to billing@helioncompute.com: "Received INV-HC-557 billed to Redwood UK and without PO reference. Please reissue to Redwood Inc referencing PO HC-2102 for $70,000 and separate invoice for $11,250 consultancy (itemized) OR provide signed approval email for the ad-hoc work and confirm tax treatment (no UK GST)."

Helion-billing: (auto-reply) Thanks we received your note and will investigate. Expect follow-up in 2 business days. Contact: accounts@helioncompute.com

Sasha: I'll pull the eng approval thread and usage logs. If Eng approves retro, Procurement can route a one-off amendment. If not, we dispute the consultancy line.

Legal: If vendor refuses to reissue or insists on UK billing, we'll request proof of tax registration and check contract billing entity clause. We might need a corrected invoice or credit note.

Ken: I can pre-approve up to $12k for professional services this quarter with Procurement+Eng justification. Send rationale and logs. Otherwise decline.

Derek: AP will keep invoice on hold until we receive either: corrected invoice referencing HC-2102 and US billing, or written approval for the $11,250 consultancy. Leaving :hourglass: reaction.

Renee: Will update when vendor responds. For now INV-HC-557 remains on hold. :white_check_mark:
